title: Monthly SaaS Metrics
description: The monthly pack a finance team sends on the 1st: an MRR bridge with live formulas, MRR by plan with trend sparklines, and the top accounts with health and renewal dates.
developerHook: Bake what your code knows, wire what readers will edit, and chart both from the same typed tables.

preview.playgroundSummary: An MRR bridge whose closing, net new and NRR are Excel formulas, MRR by plan with sparklines and a stacked area chart, and the top accounts with CRM links.
